notes.title: Update in a Hurry!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38079792/1dad1e596f41026b099607a0d27d44d07e5dacbd.png

Hurry Up guys!

I want to talk about the update we just sent you today. 
First of all, the problem with the game that you transmitted a lot, "4 player is required to play" has been solved. 
You can now play with groups of 2, 3 and 4 players. 
Second, collision problem with the background objects in cemetery map is solved. 
Third, new regulations were introduced to prevent disconnections from the game connected to the internet connection. 
Besides, we would like to give you another news. 
We will send a new update every 2 weeks until the game is fully published. 
With these updates, we think the game will reach its full version within 2-3 months. 
In this process, let's make sure that your suggestions are very important for us to develop the game all together and become a more active community.
Remember, you will decide every stage of the game from the beginning.
